endorsements.name: Riyaz Walikar
endorsements.label: Poking Servers with Facebook (and other Web Applications)
endorsements.description: Many web applications provide functionality to pull data from other websites for various reasons. Using user specified URLs, web applications can be made to fetch image files, download XML feeds from remote servers and in the case of Mozilla, text based manifest files as well. This functionality can be abused by making crafted queries using the vulnerable web application as a proxy to attack other remote servers. Attacks arising via this abuse of functionality are named as Cross Site Port Attacks.
